parties.respondent: The State Of Madhya Pradesh & ORS.

summary: Validity of stamp duty under BOT Scheme; whether toll collection right constitutes a lease under TP Act s.105 and Stamp Act; clarification by Chief Secretary dated 2002 on stamp exemption; promissory estoppel applied against State for demand of 2% stamp duty; ultra vires challenge to amendment inserting proviso (c) to Article 33 of Schedule 1(A); amendment declared unconstitutional; stamp demand of Rs.1.08 crore set aside; legitimate expectation upheld; amendment held arbitrary violating Article 14.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 s.2(16), s.48, s.48(B)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned High Court judgment set aside; stamp duty demand quashed.
